## Product scope (declaration; NOT authorization) / 产品范围（仅声明，非授权）

- [ ] Full
- [ ] Mini library / Mini 库
- [ ] Mini consumer / Workbench / Mini 消费者
- [ ] Repository governance/navigation / 仓库治理与导航
- [ ] Cross-product (requires a separate pre-authorized exact-file exception) / 跨产品（须事先另行获准的精确文件例外）

### Why / which contract is affected? / 改动原因及受影响契约

### Changed paths (including renames and workflow definitions) / 变更路径（含重命名和工作流定义）

### Evidence: tests and exact SHA / 验证证据：测试和精确 SHA

### Stable release / tag / API impact / 对 Stable 发布、标签和 API 的影响

### Review and rollback plan / 审查及回滚方案

**Notice:** Scope Guard derives authority from the trusted base policy and the actual GitHub PR file list. Checking a box, editing a label, or choosing a PR title does not authorize cross-product changes.

**提示：** Scope Guard 根据可信目标分支的策略及 GitHub PR 的实际文件清单判定授权。勾选复选框、修改标签或选择标题均不会授权跨产品改动。
